metric_formulas.blocked_recall: pair score >= 0 hits / known blocked pair support
metric_formulas.blocker_top1: top queried known-blocked neighbor hits / scenes with at least one blocked pair
metric_formulas.joint_accuracy: gate-correct and (WAIT or proposal-correct) hits / actor rows
metric_formulas.macro: unweighted mean of per-fold rates; folds with zero denominator excluded and counted
metric_formulas.micro: sum recovered integer numerators / sum explicit denominators
metric_formulas.pair_accuracy: blocked hits + safe hits / known pair support
metric_formulas.proposal_top1_top3: conditional RELEASE proposal hits / conditional RELEASE proposal rows
metric_formulas.safe_recall: pair score < 0 hits / known safe pair support
